newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IDEXX raised to attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IDEXX raised to attractive.

text.p: --Vector Securities International Inc said Monday it raised its rating on IDEXX Laboratories Inc to attractive from neutral.

--It cited the company's strong senior management team, an expectation that the animal health market fundamentals is strong (growing at 25 percent annually) and said the company is trading, net of cash, at a market value of only 1.2 times revenues.
--Vector set a one-year price target of $20 on the company's stock.
--IDEXX, which makes animal biomedical test products, was up 3/4 at 14-5/8.
